userStories.title: Add defensive text_metadata initialization in CaptionStage.run()

Check: if not hasattr(state, 'text_metadata') or state.text_metadata is None: state.text_metadata = []
Add this check BEFORE any operations that might use text_metadata
Log warning when this fallback triggers: '[US-43-005] Defensive init: text_metadata was missing/None'
